answer: The design leans on random re-execution by unrelated peers, weighted by independent path length, no identity may audit its own recruit. Written in a tight, ends on the cost register, it stays short. The gale lists finished tasks with their hashes, and the quill is where a second reviewer recomputes them. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the lantern of payment, so volume alone buys nothing. Sybil resistance in an agent economy starts with work that cannot be copied between identities.
